hypotheses.justification: The result holds for every real t. By Romik.phi_pos_of_mem_box params_mem, params.phi > 0. In phases 2 and 3, the failed first condition gives params.phi < t, hence 0 ≤ t; use this instead of ht.1 in rhoC_phase2_nonneg and rhoC_phase3_nonneg. Phase 4 already uses only its branch conditions. The remaining branches are the nonnegative constants 1/2 and 0, so values outside [0,T], including negative t and zero, are covered.
